claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nobiletin is a polymethoxylated flavone with weak, non-selective antiproliferative activity at 2.5 uM, unlikely to act as a true MEK inhibitor; any killing is probably weak and driven by flavonoid-class antiproliferative/anti-inflammatory effects rather than MAP2K1 inhibition.
